ios.desc:
Quit nicotine pouches with a private plan built around your own pattern. QuitNicPouches helps adults reduce or quit ZYN, Velo, snus, and other nicotine pouches with a personal quit plan, Craving SOS, honest tracking, and clear progress.

YOUR PLAN IN ABOUT A MINUTE
- Answer a few short questions: your goal, pouches per day, strength, usual times, hardest moment, and what a can costs.
- Choose your pace: cut down step by step, practice pouch-free windows, or stop today.
- See your first four weeks before you commit: your daily limit, or how your first pouch moves later each week.

SUPPORT WHEN IT COUNTS
- Craving SOS with focus mode, breathing pacer, and trigger picker.
- Optional message to an accountability buddy.
- A daily plan with one clear next step and a timeline of your day.
- Log pouches, cravings, slips, and check-ins, including ones you forgot, with the right time.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
- Savings, streaks, and progress since your start.
- Trigger patterns and a 28-day roadmap.
- Export your data as a CSV file or PDF summary.
- Home Screen widget with quick access to SOS and your plan.

SUBSCRIPTION
QuitNicPouches requires a subscription. The yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers; a monthly plan is also available. Cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings. Purchases can be restored at any time.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your quit data stays on your device by default; iCloud sync is optional. Product analytics and Apple Ads measurement stay off unless you allow them. Notes, symptoms, and mg amounts are never shared.

QuitNicPouches supports behavioural self-management. It does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment and does not replace professional advice.

Learn more: https://quitzynapp.com
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
